frames.narration: The chain is wired once: Manager, then Director, then CEO. Each handler only knows the one after it.
An expense of $5,000 arrives. The client hands it to the first handler and does not choose.
The manager checks its own rule: 5,000 is above 1,000. It cannot approve, so it passes the request on.
The request moves down the chain unchanged.
The director's limit is 10,000, so it handles the request. The chain stops here; the CEO is never bothered.
The answer flows back to the client. It never knew who would handle it.
Now a $50,000 request. It passes manager and director and reaches the CEO.
